gallery.title: Cenotaph
gallery.description: A vast, dark brutalist hall of smooth cast concrete, so big the air in it glows. The falling figure from Falling Repose is cut through the ceiling slab, still turning, and sunlight pours through the hole in its shape, slanting through the haze to a pool on the polished floor, over a score lost in the hall's long reverb. Click to look round with the mouse and walk with WASD (on a phone, drag and pinch); hold to hold time.
